name: ARMOR-IOS-CONTROL
notes: The iPhone client authenticates to ARMOR-SERVER with the user-facing Studio session, like the Android client. Camera credentials and RTSP URLs remain server-side. The rules of the app are in the ArmorCore Swift package, tested without a phone; the screens are built with Xcode (XcodeGen description in project.yml) and have not been run on a device yet. The project also holds the Apple Watch app of ARMOR-WATCH as an embedded watchOS target (off until the phone says so; built for the simulator in GitHub Actions, never run on a real watch). The app also runs end to end without hardware against a simulated server and a simulated watch (Tests/ArmorCoreTests/Simulation), cuts and failures included; nothing has run on an iPhone or an Apple Watch.
